extracted.intended_audience: organizations and stakeholders looking for information about Chan Zuckerberg Initiative grantmaking and the public grants database (potential grantees, researchers, journalists)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview and public disclosure terms for Chan Zuckerberg Initiative grantmaking, including what the public grants database contains, how grants are defined, and which funding entities' grants are shown. Not an application guide or scoring rubric, but describes scope and types of CZI funding that are disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with scientific grand challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: In science, our grantmaking is aligned with our four scientific grand challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates CZI's science grants are focused on predefined grand-challenge areas; prospective projects or evaluations should consider whether work aligns with those four challenges. (Page does not enumerate the four challenges here.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of grants and grantmaking
rubrics_metrics.description: *Grants and grantmaking refer to our various charitable funding types, including grants, gifts, awards, charitable sponsorships, and program-related investments (PRIs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies that CZI uses multiple funding instruments; listings in the database may represent different types of charitable funding rather than a single 'grant' form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants awarded via various funding entities
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants are awarded via various funding entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that different CZI entities (e.g., Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Foundation, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Advocacy, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative DAF) may make awards; award source may affect disclosure and possibly eligibility/process, though no detailed processes are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Database disclosure scope (start year)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants disclosed in the database from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Foundation, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Advocacy, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative DAF are from 2018.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The public grants database is retroactive to 2018 only; users seeking earlier grants should note they may not be included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Database update frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: This database of our grant giving is retroactive to 2018 and is updated twice a year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should expect semiannual updates to the public record; information such as commitment year and amount will reflect the update cadence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existence of undisclosed short-term / discretionary / exploratory grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Outside of the grants disclosed in the above database, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative also makes grants that are short-term, discretionary, or exploratory in nature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all CZI-funded activity is captured in the public database; some awards may be omitted due to short-term, discretionary, or exploratory status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public grant record fields / directory columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants Recipients Directory List — Name, Description, Amount, Commitment Year, Category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The public directory presents these specific fields for each disclosed grant; searches may return no results if filters are too narrow or search terms omitted.
